name: Stormwreck Sea
description: Vast ocean region of Ixalan between the Sun Empire and Torrezon, domain of the Brazen Coalition pirates.

description_citations.text: "Stormwreck Sea". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Spurned by the Sun Empire, the refugee flotilla scatters across the Stormwreck Sea and turns to piracy, raiding Ixalan's coast.
timeline.quote: this refugee flotilla turned to piracy

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass's Scourge rams Jareth Wake's Squid Eyes; the entangled ships stay afloat and the captains parley, founding High and Dry.
timeline.quote: After the Scourge rammed Squid Eyes , the two ships became impossibly entangled

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass turns back her expedition when she sees Realmbreaker's branches over the sky.
timeline.quote: she turned back when she saw Realmbreaker 's branches arcing over the ocean sky

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk conquers Torrezon; refugees refused harbor by the Sun Empire turn to raiding at sea.
timeline.quote: The Stormwreck Sea became a haven for outcasts when the Legion of Dusk conquered Torrezon around 98 BD .

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "Early Days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake found High and Dry on the wreckage.
timeline.quote: Their captains — Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake — founded High and Dry on the wreckage

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "Early Days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
timeline.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Beckett Brass declares the age of piracy over, makes the Coalition a legitimate nation and becomes its first Governor.
timeline.quote: Beckett Brass declared the age of piracy over

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: A floating city of lashed ships founded when two ships crashed together.
relations.quote: Founded when two ships crashed together

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Bases". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
